The '''Gravity Massive''' was one of two major [[Prison/Legends|prison]] gangs within the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Led by the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Strabo]], the Gravity Massive's greatest rival was the [[Bone Kings]].
